# pip constraints applied to CI installs only, via PIP_CONSTRAINT.
#
# These are deliberately NOT in pyproject.toml: they work around broken
# third-party artifacts rather than expressing real incompatibilities of
# VMEC++, so they must not propagate to anyone installing vmecpp.
#
# simsopt 1.11.0: the manylinux_2_28_x86_64 wheel is compiled with AVX-512
# emitted unconditionally, so "import simsoptpp" dies with SIGILL on any
# x86_64 CPU without AVX-512, including the GitHub Actions runners. simsopt's
# CMakeLists.txt falls back to "-march=native" for the wheel builds, so the
# instruction set of a released wheel depends on whichever builder CPU the
# release happened to land on. Drop this line once upstream ships a fixed
# release.
simsopt!=1.11.0
